title: Exploring the Ancient Wonder of Sigiriya
description: Discover the breathtaking beauty and rich history of Sigiriya, the Lion Rock fortress.
author: Tourvir Team
introduction: Sigiriya is one of the most remarkable historical monuments in Sri Lanka. The rock rises above the surrounding landscape and rewards the climb with wide views.

sections.heading: Climbing Sigiriya Rock
paragraphs: Visitors can climb to the summit to explore the ruins of the palace associated with King Kasyapa in the 5th century.
The route passes the famous frescoes and continues towards the giant lion paws that guard the final ascent.

sections.heading: Include Sigiriya in Your Route
paragraphs: Sigiriya is a UNESCO World Heritage site and a natural match for a journey through Sri Lanka's Cultural Triangle.
